needs_human.instructions: The agent has stopped and cannot continue until a person decides something, approves something, or does something only a person can do.

criteria.true: It asks a question, presents options to choose between, waits for approval, or needs a physical action such as unlocking a device or recording audio
criteria.false: It reports finished work, or it is waiting on another agent, a build, or anything it can carry on past by itself

needs_human.notes: Thresholds are a placeholder until someone measures them. Measured elsewhere on 300 real tool results: the 0.2-0.5 band was claimed at 25-45% and was true 0% of the time, so anything under 0.5 is a no. Add a `validated` block once you have run your own labelled set; without one, every answer is marked `thresholds: default`.

finished.instructions: The agent reports the work as finished and delivered.

criteria.true: It says the work is done, merged, shipped, or that a pull request is open
criteria.false: Work is still in progress, blocked, or abandoned

went_wrong.instructions: The report contains something that went wrong and is not yet fixed.

criteria.true: A failure, a regression, a blocker, or a defect found and left open
